cause_quote: The new CLI handoff called `setActiveEmbeddedRun(params.sessionId, cliOwner, params.sessionKey, params.sessionFile)` with a `cliOwner` that supplied `runId: params.runId` but omitted `startedAtMs`.
user_saw: The Control UI’s Working timer reset when a user reopened or reloaded a session while a claude-cli turn was still running.
summary: The fix records the logical turn’s start time when the lifecycle manager is created and passes it to the CLI owner for chat history recovery.
reasoning: I checked that #119729 added timestamp recovery for chat abort controllers and that #123189 extended it to owners in the embedded-run registry. #126566 first registered deferred CLI owners in that registry without a start timestamp, so the new recovery path fell back to the current time from its first version.
